pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in. Without this the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml are the one dependency file nobody is watching.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates are grouped for review; automerge is deliberately off. This project publishes signed bundles from scheduled workflows, so a dependency that lands without a human looking at it reaches a signing job unreviewed.
